text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Defence ministry undersecretary Sheikh Salman attends the commissioning in the United States of the new navy frigate Sabha.
- Bahrain and Germany in a draft agreement to encourage Bahraini investment.
- Crown Prince Sheikh Hamad attends joint mobilisation exercise with U.S., British forces.
- A new 10.5 million dinar Muharraq bridge linking two Bahraini cities is scheduled to be opened in December.
- Insurance firms weather tough times. Sound risk management protects companies despite a massive surge in payouts.
